qualification: Actual cross-platform source compilation and bundle/policy checks; no installed GUI, microphone hardware, provider account or delivery build was exercised by this workflow.

source_compile_environment.reason: Source-only compilation omits installer resources. The separate artifact workflow still stages and qualifies actual frozen sidecars and installer assets; no dummy runtime replaces them.

pytest.skip_reason: The compiled Objective-C policy fixture is macOS-only.
The compiled Objective-C policy fixture is macOS-only.

native_policy.macos: WKUIDelegate media permission proxy: microphone-only, main-frame, exact current loopback host origin and top-level URL receive Prompt; camera, foreign, stale-port, subframe and unready requests receive Deny. Original delegate callbacks remain forwarded. Installation failure destroys the owned WebView.
native_policy.linux: WebKitGTK PermissionRequest interception: microphone-only on the exact current workspace origin receives an explicit native Yes/No prompt, defaults to No, and revalidates the live origin before Allow. Camera and foreign requests are denied. Asynchronous decisions complete once.
native_policy.windows: WebView2 PermissionRequested interception: exact current-origin microphone requests retain the native DEFAULT permission prompt; camera and foreign requests are denied. Failed PermissionKind/Uri reads and null URI deny; failure to apply Deny destroys the owned WebView.

Current microphone request prompts; camera, combined capture, foreign origin, subframe, stale port and unready host deny

limits: The compiled macOS fixture does not invoke TCC or acquire a microphone.
Linux and Windows runtime native permission prompts are not exercised by the source test.
OS permission consent and an available PulseAudio/PipeWire/Windows/macOS audio device remain runtime prerequisites; no permission is silently granted.
Native password/keyring restart, restricted terminal transport, detach/reopen, acknowledged re-dock, session revocation and logout require the separate unchanged installed-binary WebDriver fixture.
Native OIDC TLS/WebView navigation and macOS installed GUI remain separate qualification gates.
No real paid audio/image API or provider entitlement was tested, and this evidence does not close that gate.
